decision: Freeze the completed eager c32 producer and construct its decision-bearing capture terminal from the retrieved immutable bundle without any request, server, or producer replay.

localized_failure.cause: The owner required a root EXACT_CAPTURE_TERMINAL.json and root request stdout/stderr, while the completed producer emitted c32/TERMINAL.json plus manifest-bound per-request and per-response files. The repaired bundle and bulk payload are now controller-local.

steps: Validate every compact bundle member against hidden_states.manifest.json and validate the controller-local hidden_states.pt hash and byte count.

Use the existing trusted project consumer to load the local payload and fail closed unless its schema, shape, row count, width, request mapping, finiteness, and diversity satisfy the admitted capture contract.
Require exactly 1536 rows, width 5376, all 32 request identities, at least two unique request IDs, and at least two unique hidden rows.
Persist a content-bound EXACT_CAPTURE_TERMINAL.json and a REPAIR_TERMINAL.json before changing ownership or release state.

Only after those terminals are durable, submit the hash-bound repair request so the waiting owner exits, then release the original claim with its inspected claimed_at timestamp and clear active_session.
forbidden: No new endpoint or exact-runner request.
No retrieval-head scoring or candidate experiment.
No provider create, cleanup, or retirement.
authorized_recovery.invalid_disposition: If the retrieved payload fails the capture contract, persist the exact typed negative and hashes, unblock the waiting owner, and release before the project deadline. Do not repair by replaying the producer.

success_disposition.next_scientific_step: A later director turn may admit retrieval-head scoring from the validated capture after claim release and portfolio selection.
